parameters.prompt: Stop-motion claymation style: hand-sculpted from matte modeling clay with faint thumbprints, soft rounded chunky forms, bold simple shapes and a clean readable silhouette, saturated slightly chalky colors, from the same world as a gold, crimson and cream 19th-century clay opera house. A person in a homemade robot costume, trying hard to pass as a robot. Over the head is a teal-painted cardboard box with two wide rectangular eye slots, through which a pair of human eyes peek out nervously, and a big smile drawn on the box in black marker. A ping-pong ball sits on a chunky straw on top of the box. The body is a bigger teal-painted cardboard box with strips of silver duct tape and big bottle-cap buttons. Red and white striped long sleeves, chunky garden gloves, blue jeans and sneakers, and a red and cream knitted scarf around the neck. Toy proportions: the head is big, about a third of the character's height, on a short chunky body, and the top of the head is smooth and bare. It stands on a warm wooden stage in front of a softly blurred crimson velvet curtain, in soft warm stage light. Full body, three-quarter front view, the whole character centered and in frame. A single character, no text, no logos.
